verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core is an open-source Python framework (confirmed by GitHub repo and docs noting 'CrewAI AMP extends the power of the open-source framework'), installable and runnable entirely locally via `uv tool install crewai`/pip, with no dependency on a hosted service for core Crew/Flow/Agent execution. This directly satisfies self-hosting for an AI-native/developer persona. Missing for 10: no dedicated self-hosted production deployment guide (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) or independent report of large-scale self-hosted operation.
